Table 2: Final scores on the TimesFM backbone for the ChronosBench and GIFT-Eval benchmarks, averaged across budgets, expert-feedback modes and 3 runs with different seeds. Error metrics are relative to the zero-shot geometric mean (1.0 ties zero-shot). W-ZS / W-Rand are the fraction (%) of settings beating the zero-shot median/random search. Arrows indicate whether lower (↓) or higher (↑) is better. Best per column in bold.

Arrows indicate whether lower (↓) or higher (↑) is better. Best per column in bold.

Figure 2: MD: Li–P–S–Ge solid electrolyte. Average bond-violation rate (left) and MSE to groundtruth trajectory (center) over 3 runs. Right: forecast trajectories for a representative atom (context, ground truth, and edited forecast at B = 128).

Figure 3: Ablation study of DEFT on the TimesFM and Chronos backbones under inference budgets B ∈ {32, 64, 128}. (a) Mean MASE of each ablation variant on TimesFM. (b) Effect of the number of decomposed CEM refinement rounds (nr) on TimesFM under a fixed evaluation budget, with the prior pool size reduced accordingly; dashed lines denote the random-search baseline and ⋆ indicates the best-performing configuration for each budget. (c)–(d) Corresponding results for Chronos. Panels (a)–(b) share the same TimesFM MASE axis, and panels (c)–(d) share the same Chronos MASE axis. Results for Moirai are provided in Appendix C.2.

Figure 4: DEFT edit on one NN5 series (ChronosBench) with TimesFM, B = 32. (a) Stage 1 seed-pool scan: cells are measured scores vij = score(Ti + Sj) (negative MSE, greener is better); side bars are the max-pooled uT i = maxj vij and uS j = maxi vij (Eq. 9); star marks the best pair. (b) Best score vs. cumulative queries. (c) Edited forecast; legend gives MSE relative to zero-shot.
